id./param/scenario/cs/k_260_cs_010.pack|cs_:
"Thanks, traveler! I've been to this mine
  before, so I thought it'd be a breeze,
  but I was too sure of myself.

"I was pressing color stones at random
  and ended up like that.
  I didn't expect more colors.

"By the way, traveler,
  what brings you so deep in here?

"...Huh? The Yuba chief asked you to find
  a man named Kiefer? That's great!
  I'm Kiefer!

"I'm very late, so the chief must
  have been worried, right?
  Thanks for coming to find me!

"But don't worry! I got the green jewel
  that can cure Lyla's illness in one go!

"Well, no time to waste. My wife's suffering!
  Thanks, and see you again!

"Whoa! You startled me!
  What's this monster popping out?
  I'm in a hurry! Get out of the way!

"Hmm, hmm... Monster? How rude!
  I am Ojamaro!
  Master of the way of nuisance!

"Impressed by my nuisance skills, my lord
  ordered me to obstruct all who come
  to this mine!

"...And yet you lot! You overcame
  all my nuisances and obstructed
  the obstructor...

"You are greater pests than I!
  Let's see who can be more of a
  nuisance!

"Ugh... got tangled up with a weirdo.
  I'd fight too, but I happen to
  have no weapon...

"Hmm! What are you muttering about!
  I will not be ignored, pests!
  Now, fight! Fight!

"...So he says.
  Sorry, but I'll leave it to you, traveler!
  Take him down!
